youtube_description:
Vlog 137 where we discuss with Atul Anand, a masters student in first year in RWTH Aachen, Germany about his experiences of studying in Germany. This video is dedicated to admission requirements for studying in Germany (RWTH Aachen) including GRE, TOEFL and CGPA. We specifically discuss about MS in Germany for Indians in RWTH Aachen university. Atul Anand is an Indian student in RWTH Aachen university and has been living in Aachen for more than a year! In short we cover the basic question as: How to get admission in Germany for Masters? So, after watching this video you will know about study in Germany specifically the getting in criteria for Masters in Germany. MS in Germany for Indians is a very hot topic because of the cheap or free universities for Masters in Germany !
